newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shoe retailer Brantano H1 sales up.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shoe retailer Brantano H1 sales up.

text.p: (in millions of Belgian francs unless stated)

NOTE - Brantano NV, which listed for the first time on the Brussels bourse on June 16, said the turnover of its like-for-like shops rose 4.6 percent to 1,376.2 million francs during the period compared to the first half of 1996. It also said a higher-than-expected gross margin helped boost the group results for the first six months of this year. Chairman Joris Brantegem said the group had good growth potential and aimed to boost its market share. -- Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6810, Fax +32 2 230 7710
